symptom: `create or modify demo user 'x'` on an existing user made `mxcli diff` show DemoUsers[1].Password, DemoUsers[1].UserName, DemoUsers[2].Entity … changing for users the statement never named; after exec the modified user was last in the list
cause: execCreateDemoUser modified a user by RemoveDemoUser + AddDemoUser, which appends — the user moved to the end and every later user shifted one index; AddDemoUser already updates by user name in place
insight: A remove-then-add 'update' of a list member is a reorder, and an index-keyed diff blames every sibling. Use the backend's update-in-place path. The test mock of AddDemoUser appended unconditionally, which hid that the backend contract is add-or-update; make mocks honour the contract they stand in for.
